findings.expected: Policy expects DENY for alice (user/valid) on PATCH /api/users/u_bob
findings.explanation: User 'alice' accessed resource variant 'other' that the policy reserves for its owner. Expected DENY, observed HTTP 200 with data disclosure.
reproduction: Expected: DENY, got: HTTP 200 + protected data in body
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side ownership checks on every object access (not just list views); use indirect references or verify owner_id == caller on write paths.

findings.expected: Consistent DENY for alice on resource family '/api/users' (variant other)
findings.explanation: Identity 'alice' is denied on one endpoint but allowed on a related endpoint for the same resource. One handler enforces the policy, the other does not.
findings.remediation: Align authorization across related endpoints/methods (GET vs GET, PUT vs PATCH); share one authorization helper instead of per-handler checks.
